cause_quote: The new listener used `if (event.kind !== "opened")` to call `workerEnvironmentProjections.invalidate(event.identity, event.path)`, so an ordinary `open-error` closed the active inventory.
user_saw: Worker provisioning got stuck with “Worker environment inventory has closed” after a separate database open was refused.
summary: The fix preserves admitted worker inventory through ordinary open refusals and publishes terminal retirement when a fresh open discovers durable quarantine.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #154804: worker inventory reads and writes acquired the database on each operation, so they could resume after contention cleared even though the database code already emitted `open-error`. The #154804 diff added a persistent inventory owner and a listener that permanently closed it on that existing event. The fix’s interprocess-lock test covers recovery of the same inventory after the lock clears.
